nonReplaySafe.reason: The reply that first sets a webhook URL carries the new webhook secret once; a replay after a lost reply answers without it.
The write carries expectedRevision and moves it; a replay after a lost reply answers 409 conflict although the change applied.
The write carries expectedRevision and moves it before the Space database is removed; a replay answers 409 conflict, or can never succeed after a partial failure.

availability.managedAgents: Preview: off until your organization turns on the Managed Agents feature.
availability.mail: Available: hosted with a Ryu API key that has Mail scopes or a Ryu node gateway key, or self-hosted.
availability.notify: Early access: hosted at https://notify.ryuhq.com with keys provisioned by Ryu; the self-hosted service is not yet published.
availability.box: Early access: hosted at https://box.ryuhq.com and enabled per organization by Ryu; the self-hosted service is not yet published.
availability.gateway: Self-hosted: run Ryu Gateway with your own provider keys.
availability.connect: Early access: hosted keys are provisioned by Ryu; the self-hosted service is not yet published.
availability.passport: Early access: hosted keys are provisioned by Ryu; the self-hosted service is not yet published.
availability.sites: Early access: self-hosted process only, and standalone mode needs a ryu-sites release after 0.4.0, which is not published yet; there is no Ryu-hosted offer.
availability.messaging: Early access: hosted on the Ryu control plane; Ryu enables it per organization, and the organization must also turn on its Ryu Messaging feature (off by default); there is no self-hosted service.
